{{Quote|Beldorion has drafted me into editing and retaping his formidable library of Huttese pornography.|Liegeus Vorn|<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Holoporn''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] form of [[pornography]] that could be found on [[Black market/Legends|black markets]] of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|against]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Kailio Entertainments]] corporation and [[Lucin Syndicate]] were involved in legal and illegal holoporn respectively. By [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Beldorion]] owned a formidable library of holographic Huttese pornography, for which he hired the [[holo faker]] [[Liegeus Vorn]] to edit and retape.

==Description==
Holoporn was [[pornography]] in the form of [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]. Some holoporn was legal, but illegal holoporn existed as well.<ref name="GG11" />

==History==
{{Talesstart}}
{{Quote|I've gotta shipment of holographic ''Hutt-smut'' that absolutely, positively ''must'' be delivered overnight to the ''Kurluvion'' system. They just ''love'' Hutt-smut there, can't get enough.|A Snivvian|<ref name="SB">{{Tales|14|Smuggler's Blues}}</ref>}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="SBDate">"[[Smuggler's Blues]]" takes place concurrently with the portion of {{Film|IV}} that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was approached by a [[Unidentified Snivvian (Chalmun's Cantina)|Snivvian]] while looking for prospective clients in<ref name="SB" /> [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'', 2005 edition]]</ref> The [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] claimed that they had a shipment of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] holoporn to be delivered to the [[Kurluvion system/Legends|Kurluvion system]], telling the smuggler that the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] population loved holographic Hutt pornography. Solo informed the Snivvian that<ref name="SB" /> he<ref name="CL" /> had integrity and considered being [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] preferable to smuggling Hutt holoporn, declining the job offer.<ref name="SB" />
{{Talesend}}

[[File:Kailio_Entertainments.svg|thumb|right|220px|Kailio Entertainments (logo pictured) was a holoporn distributor.]]
It was possible to find pornographic holos on [[Black market/Legends|black markets]] of planets either affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|against]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> or located near the Rebellion's bases<ref name="GG6 2nd" /> between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="GG6Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'' and its [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|second edition]] are both set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|VI}}, which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and approximately [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="TCGDate">The ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' expansion of [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]] takes place at some point during [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]{{'s}} events, which are set between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and approximately [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:SWG timeline|here]].</ref> a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] watched a hologram of<ref name="SWG Thought">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Thought as Action}}</ref> the [[virtual reality]]<ref name="Insider23">{{InsiderCite|23|The Star Wars Holiday Special (article)|''The Star Wars Holiday Special''}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Mermeia]]<ref name="Insider106">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref> dancing.<ref name="SWG Thought" />

Around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="GG11Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'' is set around six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|VI}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the Hutt-owned [[Kailio Entertainments]] was a distributor for one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] biggest holoporn industries and the [[Lucin Syndicate]] ran a major [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] production and distribution center of illegal holographic pornography on the planet [[Majilop]].<ref name="GG11" /> By [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="PoTDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> the Hutt ruler of the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], [[Beldorion]], was in possession of a formidable collection of Huttese holoporn, commissioning the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[holo faker]] [[Liegeus Vorn]] to edit and retape his library.<ref name="PoT" /> That year,<ref name="PoTDate" /> Vorn told the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] representative [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] about it and confessed that even his previous job of ghost-writing love [[Poet/Legends|poems]] for [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] did not make him as scared.<ref name="PoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Holoporn was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', written by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]],<ref name="GG6" /> and identified as such in the ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'' sourcebook for the same [[roleplaying game]], written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by West End Games in [[1994]].<ref name="GG11" />
